scripts.allure:history: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const path=require('path'); const src=path.join('allure-report','history'); const dst=path.join('allure-results','history'); if(fs.existsSync(src)){ fs.mkdirSync(dst,{recursive:true}); for(const f of fs.readdirSync(src)){ fs.cpSync(path.join(src,f),path.join(dst,f),{recursive:true}); } console.log('history copied'); } else { console.log('no previous history'); }"
scripts.allure:trend: pnpm run allure:history && pnpm run allure:generate && pnpm run allure:open
